outcome: Combined respiratory morbidity (tachypnea and respiratory distress syndrome)
Apgar score <7 at 5 minutes of age
cohort: 1,466 women who underwent elective lower segment cesarean section for uncomplicated singleton pregnancies (758 early term and 708 full term)
finding: Infants born by elective caesarean section prior to full term gestation had a significantly higher risk of respiratory morbidities, particularly the need for oxygen support.
mod_finding: Infants born by elective cesarean section prior to full term gestation have a significant risk of respiratory morbidities.
